biocontainers.name: bioconductor-epitxdb
biocontainers.summary: Storing and accessing epitranscriptomic information using the annotationdbi interface

biotools.summary: EpiTxDb facilitates the storage of epitranscriptomic information. More specifically, it can keep track of modification identity, position, the enzyme for introducing it on the RNA, a specifier which determines the position on the RNA to be modified and the literature references each modification is associated with.
